learning_outcomes.text: Students will have acquired a solid general knowledge of electrochemical storage.
They will be able to analyze and solve problems, carry out calculations, choose and size energy solutions according to specifications.
They will also be able to innovate by proposing alternatives to existing solutions.
Know the different types of electrochemical storage and how to size them.
Know how to use basic redox relationships.
Be able to carry out a relevant study to choose an energy source adapted to a given problem, arguing their choice by calculation.

syllabus_topics: Electrical model of an electrochemical cell
Interconnection between batteries and other storage sources
